evidence.title: Evidence type
evidence.description: ABRA Flexi evidence path to write

id_column.title: ID column
id_column.description: Input column whose value identifies the record

id_type.title: ID type
id_type.description: ext = upsert on external ID; internal = update by FlexiBee numeric ID

fail_on_error.title: Fail on error
fail_on_error.description: Abort the job on the first record error instead of routing to write_errors

load_mapping.title: Load columns & FlexiBee fields
load_mapping.description: Adds a mapping row for each input column not yet mapped and loads the evidence's FlexiBee fields as destination options. Existing rows are preserved.

column_mapping.title: Column Mapping
column_mapping.description: Maps input CSV columns to FlexiBee field names. Only mapped columns are sent; unmapped columns are dropped. Leave empty to send all columns as-is.

source.title: Source Column
source.description: Column name from the input CSV file

destination.title: FlexiBee Field
destination.description: Target FlexiBee field (e.g. nazev, ulice, psc). Pick from the loaded fields or type one.
